analyst.summary: Engineers India is a debt-free PSU engineering-consultancy franchise that just posted record revenue, profit, and order book on the back of India's refinery and petrochemical capex cycle. We checked whether the sharp one-year growth acceleration (versus a much slower 3-year average) was a one-off base effect, and it was not -- the order book itself grew nearly 29% to a record high, and management's own guidance points to continued, if more moderate, growth next year. We rate this a Hold: fundamentals are genuinely improving, but the valuation already reflects a good part of that, and the business remains tied to lumpy, cyclical energy-sector capex decisions.
